6.2.8.2.4 Memory Abstraction Interface
Detection
Reported by the Eeprom Abstraction (see EEPROM Abstraction above), only if the stack is
configured in polling mode
Reaction
N/A
Report
Depending on the configuration:
• The error shall be polled by the NVRAM manager with the function MemIf_GetJobResult (job
result set to MEMIF_JOB_FAILED) (see: [MemIf043] [MemIf053]).
Recovery
See NVRAM Manager.
